title: Run, install, and use Rongmei Hymnal
summary: Preview the static application locally, then install it from its HTTPS deployment and explicitly download songbook data for offline reading.
steps: Clone the repository and start a static HTTP server from its root; opening files directly through file:// will not reproduce service-worker behavior.
Open http://localhost:8000 and search or select a registered songbook to verify the library and reading views.
For installation, open the HTTPS deployment in a supported browser and choose Install app or Add to Home Screen.
Choose Download for offline inside the application, monitor progress and storage status, and wait for completion before disconnecting.
Use the home-page controls to refresh or remove the downloaded library. Browser quota and persistence remain controlled by the operating system.
Review the usage policy before redistributing lyrics, editions, arrangements, recordings, or cover art.
command:
git clone https://github.com/Guang84/RongmeiHymnal.git
cd RongmeiHymnal
python3 -m http.server 8000
audience: Readers, maintainers, and community users who want to run or install the static hymnal application.
prerequisites: Python 3 or another static HTTP server for local preview
HTTPS deployment for installation and service-worker features
verification: Search and reading views work at phone and desktop widths
The app can be installed from the HTTPS deployment
Downloaded collections remain available after disconnecting and reopening the application
troubleshooting: Do not open the application through file:// when testing service-worker or offline behavior.
If installation is unavailable, confirm the deployment uses HTTPS and the browser supports PWA installation.
If offline data is missing, reconnect and complete the in-app download before disconnecting.
